scope: Single sequential headless Chromium run on local software WebGL; development server; same actual default-open aggregate cells; setup includes JS renderer creation after module imports, excludes network. Render submit is CPU walltime, not GPU frame rate. No physical mobile, user task or whole-browser memory claim.

productionBuild.note: Entry chunk sizes exclude shared aggregate data/module-preload and possible deck dynamic expression chunks. Actual application R3F chunk measured separately.

decision: Use Three/R3F for initial bounded custom scenes: smaller core-renderer entry and lower measured CPU submission cost in this single software-WebGL run. No general claim of better GPU frame rate or analyst task performance. Keep 2D default and defer human-task acceptance.
